raw_text: Watching this after stopping my Groww SIP. Can I change my SIP date easily? Currently on 2nd, want to change to 10th because salary comes late. App asked me to delete current SIP and start new one with new mandate. Too complex. (comment #685)

TradingQ&A thread summary: I find the Groww portfolio dashboard completely unhelpful for first-timers. It shows current value, invested value, 1D return, and XIRR. But it doesn't show: 'How many units did you buy at lower prices during this dip?' Without that, every dip feels like pure financial loss. (comment #723)

Bhai exact same thing happened to me. I stopped my SIP at Month 10. Not because I lost money, but because I had zero feedback on whether I was on track for anything. Investing feels completely lonely and robotic. There's no celebration when you hit 10 consecutive months without failing. (comment #729)

Can someone explain XIRR to a beginner? Started SIP 2 months ago (2 installments of 2500). Groww shows XIRR -34.8%! I panicked thinking 34% of my capital was wiped out. It took 3 hours of googling and reddit threads to realize XIRR annualizes short term movements. Why doesn't Groww explain this inside the app instead of scaring first-timers with annualised percentages? (comment #284)
